lane: runner-gates-final: studio-runner default, fixtures and deployment tiers, contracts/codegen and static checks on the FINAL tree
verdict: All five gates GREEN. Every attempt was green on the first try, with no reruns needed and no red to classify: default tier 2/2, fixtures tier 2/2, observed-secret-control 10/10, deployment tier 2/2, contracts/codegen 1/1 and static checks 1/1. Gate 1 thresholds are unchanged. The no-exclusion measurement fails src/run/** lines and statements at 81.22%, as expected and as recorded before. No product, test or config file was edited. No defect was found.
